title: Automated Legacy Data Migration Orchestration
business: Financial institutions managing decades of fragmented mainframe records.
problem: Manual data extraction and transformation processes are prone to human error and high latency, leading to inconsistent database synchronization across legacy systems.
solution: Utilizing the OpenHands Agent Server to execute tool-driven workflows that automate the extraction, validation, and migration of data records within isolated, secure sandbox environments.
steps: Initialize the Agent Server to expose the remote execution API for secure task management.
Define custom tools within the Software Agent SDK to interface with legacy database schemas.
Configure the Sandbox Server to provide isolated environments for each migration batch.
Deploy the Agent Canvas to monitor the model-driven workflow and verify tool call outputs.
Execute the migration sequence via the Agent Server API to ensure consistent state transitions.
outcome: A reliable, repeatable migration pipeline that reduces manual intervention while maintaining strict data integrity through isolated execution.
limitation: The primary limitation is the overhead of managing isolated sandbox environments for complex tasks; this can be verified by monitoring the latency of the Sandbox Server during high-concurrency migration batches.

To act as a storage repository for all migrated financial records.

questions.question: In Automated Legacy Data Migration Orchestration, what is a key limitation of the proposed implementation?
options: The inability to use the Software Agent SDK for custom tools.
The overhead of managing isolated sandbox environments for complex tasks.
The requirement to use the Legacy Local GUI for all operations.
The lack of support for REST and WebSocket APIs.
